blocks.en: If you are looking for a step-by-step guide on how to efficiently complete the AIR Career Program see Guide to AIR Career Programme
blocks.zh: 如果你想找一份高效完成 AIR 职业计划的分步指南，请参阅 AIR 职业计划指南

blocks.en: How to access the AIR Career Program window
blocks.zh: 如何打开 AIR 职业计划窗口

blocks.en: The AIR Career Program rewards players for reaching certain goals. The rewards for a single goal are a small amount of ISK and career points (CP) but sometimes also items. The goals are grouped into four categories which each have ten sub-categories. Reaching all goals in one category gives a total of a thousand CP. When you reach three-quarter completion of a category, i.e. 750 CP, you graduate for that category and receive 100k skill points (SP) plus SKINs. Furthermore, you gain SP based upon your total CP. You can gain a total of 750k SP per character through the AIR Career Program.
blocks.zh: AIR 职业计划（AIR Career Program）会在玩家达成特定目标时给予奖励。单个目标的奖励是少量 ISK 和职业点数（CP），有时还有物品。目标分为四个职业类别，每个类别下有十个子类别。完成一个类别中的所有目标总共可获得 1000 CP。当某个类别的完成度达到四分之三，即 750 CP 时，你就从该类别毕业，获得 10 万技能点以及涂装（SKIN）。此外，你还会根据总 CP 获得技能点。每个角色通过 AIR 职业计划总共可获得 75 万技能点。

blocks.en: While you will reach most goals through your normal activities as a new player, you probably have to strive beyond those to obtain all the available SP. Thus the system encourages you to try out activities which you otherwise would not have tried.
blocks.zh: 作为新玩家，大多数目标在日常活动中就能达成，但要拿到全部技能点，你可能需要做一些平时不会做的事。因此，这个系统会鼓励你去尝试那些原本不会尝试的活动。

blocks.en: There are rewards for completing particular goals, but also for graduating from a career by completing 75% of its goals, and for reaching certain milestones in the overall program.
blocks.zh: 完成特定目标会有奖励，完成某个职业 75% 的目标从该职业毕业也有奖励，在整个计划中达到特定里程碑同样有奖励。

blocks.en: Each goal provides an amount of Career Points, which are used as the measurement of progression in each Career and the AIR Career Program overall. There are 4,000 CP to collect, 1,000 in each career.
blocks.zh: 每个目标都会提供一定数量的职业点数，用来衡量你在各个职业以及整个 AIR 职业计划中的进度。总共有 4,000 CP 可以收集，每个职业 1,000 CP。
从某个职业毕业时获得

blocks.en: for each goal reached. Amounts vary between 12k and 125k per goal.
blocks.zh: 每达成一个目标获得。每个目标的金额在 12k 到 125k 之间。

blocks.en: Item rewards will be delivered to ship cargo, home station or to the current station the character is currently in. Skill Point and ISK Rewards will be automatically redeemed to the Characters account .

blocks.zh: 箱子的内容取决于开箱角色所属的势力。箱子可以通过市场或合同交易[待核实]。

blocks.en: Each goal has a section in which Aura provides tips and guidance in the form of links to fittings, modules, skills, specific locations, and pointers to relevant UI windows.
blocks.zh: 每个目标都有一个栏目，Aura 会在其中提供提示和指导，包括装配、装备、技能、具体地点的链接，以及相关界面窗口的指引。

blocks.en: The goals which are categorized in four careers split into ten activities, each with three to ten goals, for a total of 188 goals. Each goal reached will give a reward. A goal can be tracked which will display its progress in the Info Panel outside of the AIR Career Program window, but tracking isn't required to complete goals since they progress passively during normal gameplay. All capsuleers start the program from the beginning. An older character's activities before the program's introduction do not count.
blocks.zh: 目标分为四个职业，每个职业又分为十项活动，每项活动有三到十个目标，总共 188 个目标。每达成一个目标都会获得奖励。你可以追踪某个目标，让它的进度显示在 AIR 职业计划窗口之外的信息面板中，但不追踪也能完成目标，因为它们会在正常游戏过程中自动推进。所有克隆飞行员都从头开始这个计划。老角色在该计划推出之前的活动不计入。

blocks.en: Each career category contains an activity to do the corresponding career agent missions. Aura's assistance redirects you to the agency section for career agents which will direct you to the career agents corresponding to your school i.e. starting corporation. Since you can complete Career missions only once, if the designated agent does not have any jobs for you, please set destination to another agent to complete the mission.
blocks.zh: 每个职业类别都包含一项完成相应生涯代理人任务的活动。Aura 的协助会把你引导到代理处的生涯代理人页面，并指引你前往与你的学校（即新手军团）对应的生涯代理人。由于生涯任务只能完成一次，如果指定的代理人没有任务给你，请把目的地设为其他代理人来完成任务。

blocks.en: Many of the goals are related. For example, if you finish the combat sites goal for the enforcer, you automatically finish the combat sites goal for the explorer. Some rewards help you with other goals: the refining activity provides you with BPCs which you can then use for the manufacturing activity.
blocks.zh: 许多目标是相互关联的。例如，完成执法者的战斗站点目标后，探险家的战斗站点目标也会自动完成。有些奖励能帮助你完成其他目标：提炼活动会奖励蓝图拷贝，你可以用它们来完成制造活动。

blocks.en: If you want to work through the goals, it's a good idea to start with the career agents and the do the SoE epic arc as you already cover about one-third of the possible CP.
blocks.zh: 如果你想逐一完成这些目标，最好先从生涯代理人开始，然后做姐妹会史诗任务线，这样就已经拿到了约三分之一的 CP。

blocks.en: Participate in the given number of duels. People are very reluctant to accept duels from strangers thus you probably best do this with a friend. You can have duels with several players at once but only one open duel invitation. You can sent a new duel invitation to a player after the limited engagement timer has run down.
blocks.zh: 参加指定次数的决斗。大家通常很不愿意接受陌生人的决斗邀请，所以最好和朋友一起完成。你可以同时与多名玩家决斗，但同一时间只能有一个未处理的决斗邀请。有限交战计时器结束后，你才能向同一名玩家发送新的决斗邀请。
